## App behavior

- The app generates text combinations by selecting one item from each category in order.
- It creates one `.txt` file per first-category item.
- Each combination is written on its own line with a blank line between combinations.

## Download

- `TextCombinatorWinForms.exe` (self-contained, single-file, Windows x64)

## Verification

- [ ] App opens without Visual Studio
- [ ] Category add/remove works
- [ ] Item add/remove works
- [ ] Output folder selection works
- [ ] Generated files match expected combinations
- [ ] Output includes blank line spacing between combinations
